# Insighte

> > Insighte is a specialized child mental health and therapy platform providing neurodiversity-affirming care, counseling, and inclusive education support for autism, ADHD, and learning differences across India.

Founded in 2015, Insighte offers comprehensive mental health and educational services including child therapy, counseling, shadow teaching, and school inclusion support. The organization operates in Bangalore and Kerala with a team of expert psychologists, therapists, and special educators committed to neurodiversity-affirming approaches.

## Key Topics

- Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
- ADHD (Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder)
- Neurodiversity-Affirming Therapy
- Child Psychology & Therapy
- Special Education & Learning Support
- Shadow Teachers
- School Inclusion & Integration
- Mental Health Counseling
- Behavior Therapy & CBT
- Early Intervention
- Dyslexia Support
- Play & Art Therapy
- IEP (Individualized Education Plan)
- Family Counseling
- School Mental Health Programs
